problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — New Tippasandra (2019–2021)
problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in New Tippasandra between February 2019 and March 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 20% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 82 pothole complaints.
27 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹11.9 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).
Ward recorded 119 road crashes in 2024, of which 21 were fatal.

agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.40). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, crash_risk=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.20.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='New Tippasandra' matched to datameet243=122 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.712).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for New Tippasandra for the period 2019–2021.
Request inspection records for the 27 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
